steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep1-b11-seedB"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/v34-r2/11-grow-LTX-seedB.mp4*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep1-b11-seedB-0813.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 1 else 1)
